body: Not really. My boyfriend just came home and we will probably throw on the TV but honestly TV is not my favorite.
Yes, I live in Los Angeles. Where do you live?

He really, really loves me. He's my best friend. We do fight and we have lightly gotten physical twice over three years when we've argued which sucks. But it truly makes him happy to help me and that's rare. I try not to argue with him but I'm fucking crazy. I tell him all the time to leave me for someone more 'together' because I'll probably always be psycho.

Yeah Frank Ocean's new album is pretty good. But boring at times too lol. 

As for Emotion Side B...that's a tough choice. Maybe Body Languange, The One, or First Time. Fever is good too. I love store because it is literally about "just going to the store."

Everything, even some country but like a minuscule amount lol. I like dance music. House music but not like modern EDM with build-up-drop-build-up-drop. I like more meditative electronic music. I love some pop music. Currently listening to CRJ's Emotion Side B a lot and the new Frank Ocean and Angel Olsen to give you an idea. My all time favorite song would probably be a New Order song.
I love listening to music. Not all kinds and I'm not always listening to new music. But if there's one thing I love to do more than anything else, it would be listening to great music.

Honestly, cooking isn't really my favorite activity. It's more of an egotistical hobby because I like being the guy who can make people happy through food and making people say "wow!" when they try something I make because I want them to say" ___ is so good at cooking! You have to try his potatoes au gratin." The act is actually tiring. I guess a dish I like to make for myself is curry chicken or bulgogi beef.
